title: Terraform module for Cloud NSS to Microsoft Sentinel

prose.label: Credentials and outputs.
prose.text: {{aad-app}} {{outputs}} The Cloud NSS feed's own Sentinel fields are in [[zia.api.cloud-nss-feeds]].

checks.do: Which tables exist and what their names are, since a name without _CL gets it appended and disabled log types create nothing.
What the Cloud NSS feed needs from the module: the endpoint URL per table, the application ID, tenant ID and secret.

support.statement: The Sentinel Cloud NSS Terraform module is community supported: Zscaler employees still support it, but Zscaler support does not, and issues go to its GitHub Issues.

quotes: This Terraform module is community supported. Although the module is still supported by Zscaler employees, it is **NOT** supported by Zscaler support.
Please open all enhancement requests and issues on [Github Issues](https://github.com/zscaler/terraform-azurerm-zia-sentinel-cloud-nss/issues) for support.

purpose.statement: The module deploys the Azure side of a Zscaler Cloud NSS to Microsoft Sentinel integration: Sentinel and Log Analytics workspaces, Data Collection Endpoints, Data Collection Rules and custom tables, one table per supported log type: Web, DNS and Firewall.

quotes: The module contains all the necessary resources required to deploy Azure Sentinel, including Azure Sentinel workspaces, Log Analytics workspaces, Data Collection Endpoints, Data Collection Rules, and custom tables.
This template is designed to create individual custom tables for all Zscaler's supported log ingestion types: Web, DNS, and Firewall logs.

tables.statement: Each of the web, firewall and DNS log tables is disabled by default, needs a non-empty table_name when enabled, and has _CL appended to its name when the name does not already end in _CL.

workspace.statement: The workspace SKU defaults to PerGB2018 and retention to 90 days, with retention validated between 30 and 730 days; the module enables the SecurityInsights solution on the workspace.

dce.statement: The Data Collection Endpoint kind defaults to Windows (Linux is the only other value) and the endpoint has public network access enabled.

quotes: Possible values are Linux and Windows

dcr-flow.statement: For each enabled table the Data Collection Rule declares a Custom stream and a data flow that applies a KQL transform and writes to the Microsoft-CommonSecurityLog output stream.

aad-app.statement: The module registers an Azure AD application with a service principal and a generated client secret, and grants it the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role scoped to the Data Collection Rule.

outputs.statement: The module outputs the application ID, tenant ID, a sensitive client secret, the logs ingestion endpoint, the rule's immutable ID and an endpoint URL that uses api-version 2021-11-01-preview unless api_version is changed.

quotes: The password for this application, which is generated by Azure Active Directory.

provider-pins.statement: The module pins azurerm to ~> 3.60.0, azuread to ~> 2.39.0 and azapi to ~> 1.7.0, and sets the azurerm provider so that resource groups are deleted even if they still contain resources.

stale.statement: The module's changelog dates its 1.3.0 entry 2023-07-03.

quotes: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
